verdict.rationale: Notte's scraping docs show structured extraction against a Pydantic `BaseModel` schema (`HackerNewsFeed(BaseModel)`), and its Fetch feature returns LLM-extracted structured data rather than only markdown or raw text. One community user reported extraction failing on hyatt.com, but that is a single site-specific anecdote and does not contradict the typed-schema capability. Missing for 10: TypeScript/Zod-style schema support, documentation of validation and error behavior when output doesn't match the schema, and independent hands-on corroboration of typed extraction.
